formulas.name: ExtractErrorMessageFormula
formulas.expression: IF( AND( CONTAINS({!$Flow.FaultMessage}, "This error occurred"), CONTAINS({!$Flow.FaultMessage}, ". You can look up ExceptionCode"), FIND("This error occurred", {!$Flow.FaultMessage}) < FIND(". You can look up ExceptionCode", {!$Flow.FaultMessage}) ), TRIM( MID( {!$Flow.FaultMessage}, FIND(":", {!$Flow.FaultMessage}, FIND("This error occurred", {!$Flow.FaultMessage})) + 2, FIND(". You can look up ExceptionCode", {!$Flow.FaultMessage}) - (FIND(":", {!$Flow.FaultMessage}, FIND("This error occurred", {!$Flow.FaultMessage})) + 2) ) ), TRIM({!$Flow.FaultMessage}) )
